cycle.note: Since 2024, Nevada requires 40 hours every calendar year, including 2 of ethics. The permit renews every year.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: At least 40 hours each calendar year (NAC 628.210).

requirements.label: Accounting & auditing
requirements.note: In any year you work on an audit, review, full-disclosure compilation or attestation: 8 hours of accounting and auditing.

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: 2 hours of professional ethics each year.

newLicensee.note: Your first annual renewal of an initial permit is exempt.

practiceOptions.label: Audits, reviews, full-disclosure compilations or attestation

licenseDateHint: Nevada permits renew every year. CPE is tracked by calendar year.
issueDateHint: If your permit was first issued this year, no CPE is due for the first renewal.
limitsNotTracked: Instructor preparation: max twice the presentation time.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for 3 years after filing the renewal.
toVerify: Older summaries show the pre-2024 rule (80 hours over two years); the app uses the 2024 rule.
